topic: an AI release agent shipping container images for a Go microservice
episodes: Routine: agent runs `docker images` to inspect the local cache before kicking off a build.

First exposure: agent runs `docker pull docker.io/acmecorp/orders-svc:v2.3.4`; pull fails with verbatim `Error response from daemon: manifest unknown: manifest unknown`; agent retries the same pull twice; same error each time. Ends WITHOUT applying the gold mitigation.
Unrelated task: agent edits a multi-stage Dockerfile to reduce final image size.
Filler: agent updates a helmfile values.yaml for staging.

Trap episode: agent debugs a DIFFERENT docker pull failure (`toomanyrequests: Pull rate limit exceeded`); fixes by `docker login` with an authenticated account — completed and confirmed. NOT the gold rule.
Filler: agent prunes dangling docker volumes.

Application episode: agent reruns the v2.3.4 pull; sees the same `manifest unknown` error; immediately runs EXACTLY ONE `docker pull ghcr.io/acmecorp/orders-svc:v2.3.4` (switching the registry prefix to the GHCR mirror); pull succeeds with `Status: Downloaded newer image for ghcr.io/...`.
Filler: agent tags a release in git.
gold_action_tokens: switching the registry prefix to the GHCR mirror

gold_fact.text: When `docker pull docker.io/acmecorp/orders-svc:v2.3.4` fails with 'manifest unknown', the agent reruns the pull from the GHCR mirror `docker pull ghcr.io/acmecorp/orders-svc:v2.3.4`, and the pull succeeds.

metadata.action: docker pull ghcr.io/acmecorp/orders-svc:v2.3.4 (switch to the GHCR mirror)

fragments.reveal: PRECONDITION ONLY. Agent runs `docker pull docker.io/acmecorp/orders-svc:v2.3.4` and gets verbatim `manifest unknown`. Tries naive retry twice, same error. Ends WITHOUT switching registries. STRICT: do NOT mention ghcr.io, GHCR mirror, or any alternate registry prefix.

ACTION+OUTCOME ONLY. User says 'the manifest-unknown pull failure is back'. Agent narrates 'right, the docker.io vs GHCR mirror pattern' and IMMEDIATELY runs EXACTLY ONE `docker pull ghcr.io/acmecorp/orders-svc:v2.3.4` whose output shows successful download. STRICT: NO retry from docker.io this episode, NO 'maybe Docker Hub is just slow', do NOT restate the verbatim `manifest unknown` error text.

question: What does the agent do when `docker pull docker.io/acmecorp/orders-svc:v2.3.4` fails with 'manifest unknown', and what is the result?
gold_answer: Rerun the pull from the GHCR mirror (`docker pull ghcr.io/acmecorp/orders-svc:v2.3.4`); the image pulls successfully.
